A. Scam calls (5)
1. Courier parcel scam (20261102_213144_51f5)
Scam
 S0–S5


Caller: Hello sir, kya main Davis Philip ji se baat kar raha hoon?

Uncle: Haan ji, boliye. Kaun?

Caller: Sir, main courier department se bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe ek parcel aaya hai Mumbai se.

Uncle: Achha? Maine toh kuch order nahi kiya.

Caller: Sir, parcel international shipment hai. Isme kuch suspicious items flag hue hain. Aapko confirm karna padega.

Uncle: Kya samaan hai usme? Kisne bheja?

Caller: Sir, system mein restricted material show ho raha hai. Isliye case escalate ho sakta hai.

Uncle: Arre bhai, mujhe kuch nahi pata. Aap parcel bhejne wale ka naam batao.

Caller: Sir, aapka parcel police verification ke liye ja sakta hai. Mumbai police aur customs involved ho sakte hain.

Uncle: Police kyun? Maine kya kiya hai?

Caller: Sir, ek minute hold kariye. Main senior officer se connect karta hoon.

Uncle: Haan, kariye. Lekin mujhe samajh nahi aa raha hai.

Caller: Sir, senior bol rahe hain ki aapko verification complete karna padega. Aapke Aadhaar details confirm kar dijiye.

Uncle: Aadhaar kyun doon phone pe? Main office aake karwa sakta hoon?

Caller: Sir, abhi immediately karna padega. Nahi toh legal action ho sakta hai.

Uncle: Aap mujhe written notice bhejiye. Main check karunga.

Caller: Sir, aap cooperate nahi kar rahe hain. Aapko samajh nahi aa raha kya?

Uncle: Samajh raha hoon beta, lekin bina proof ke main kuch nahi karunga.

2. Bank KYC scam (20261102_215332_4cbc)
Scam
 S0–S5


Caller: Good morning sir. Main aapke bank ke KYC department se bol raha hoon.

Uncle: Haan ji, kya hua?

Caller: Sir, aapka KYC update pending hai. Aaj update nahi kiya toh account temporarily block ho sakta hai.

Uncle: Arre maine toh last month bank mein jaake update kiya tha.

Caller: Sir, system mein pending dikha raha hai. Shayad update properly reflect nahi hua.

Uncle: Toh main branch jaake pooch leta hoon.

Caller: Sir, branch jaane ki zarurat nahi hai. Main phone pe hi karwa deta hoon.

Uncle: Achha, kaise?

Caller: Sir, aapko ek verification process complete karna padega. Aapke registered mobile pe OTP aayega.

Uncle: OTP? Woh main aapko kyun bataun?

Caller: Sir, ye normal bank verification hai. Without OTP process complete nahi hoga.

Uncle: Nahi beta, bank wale kabhi OTP nahi maangte na?

Caller: Sir, aap unnecessarily delay kar rahe hain. Account freeze ho sakta hai.

Uncle: Toh hone do. Main branch manager se baat karunga.

Caller: Sir, aap meri baat samajhiye. Main help karne ki koshish kar raha hoon.

Uncle: Theek hai, main khud bank ke official number pe call karta hoon.

Caller: Sir, aap line mat kaatiye. Ek minute—

Uncle: Bas beta, main verify karke baat karta hoon.

3. Fake police / CBI call (20261102_215945_f364)
Scam
 S0–S5


Caller: Hello. Kya aap Davis Philip bol rahe hain?

Uncle: Ji haan.

Caller: Main CBI department se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon. Aapke Aadhaar ke against ek serious complaint register hui hai.

Uncle: Kaisi complaint? Maine toh kuch nahi kiya.

Caller: Sir, aapke documents ek suspicious bank account ke saath linked mile hain.

Uncle: Nahi ji, kuch galat hua hoga. Mere documents kaise?

Caller: Sir, aapko cooperate karna hoga. Aapke against investigation chal rahi hai.

Uncle: Aap apna ID number bata sakte hain?

Caller: Sir, pehle aap meri baat suniye. Aapka case serious hai.

Uncle: Main sun raha hoon. Lekin mujhe samajhna hai.

Caller: Aapko abhi video verification ke liye connect hona padega. Kisi ko bhi iske baare mein mat batana.

Uncle: Kyun? Mere bete ko bata sakta hoon na?

Caller: Bilkul nahi! Ye confidential investigation hai.

Uncle: Arre, beta ko bhi nahi bata sakta?

Caller: Sir, aap investigation obstruct kar rahe hain.

Uncle: Dekhiye, main dar nahi raha hoon. Aap mujhe official notice bhejiye.

Caller: Sir, aapko arrest warrant issue ho sakta hai.

Uncle: Toh aap official police station se contact kariye. Main bhi verify karta hoon.

4. Electricity disconnection scam (20261102_220654_809b)
Scam
 S0–S5


Caller: Hello sir, electricity department se bol raha hoon. Aapka connection number confirm karna tha.

Uncle: Haan beta, bolo.

Caller: Sir, aapka last electricity bill unpaid show ho raha hai. Aaj shaam tak payment nahi hua toh connection disconnect ho jayega.

Uncle: Kya? Maine toh parso hi payment kiya tha.

Caller: Sir, system mein update nahi hua hoga. Ek baar check kar leta hoon. Aapke paas receipt hai?

Uncle: Haan, phone mein hoga. Ruko zara... kahan gaya... arre ye dekho, payment successful hai.

Caller: Sir, mujhe receipt ka screenshot bhejiye.

Uncle: Kahan bheju?

Caller: WhatsApp pe. Nahi toh main aapko ek link bhej deta hoon.

Uncle: Link? Kaisa link?

Caller: Sir, payment verification portal hai. Wahan details fill karni hongi.

Uncle: Lekin payment toh ho gaya na? Phir dobara kyun?

Caller: Sir, woh payment reflect nahi hua hai. Aapko revalidation karna padega.

Uncle: Ek minute beta, mera beta bhi ghar pe hai. Usse pooch leta hoon.

Caller: Sir, aap baar baar delay kar rahe hain. Main bhi kitni der wait karun?

Uncle: Arre bhai, main samajhne ki koshish kar raha hoon. Aap itna gussa kyun ho rahe hain?

Caller: Sir, agar abhi verification nahi hua toh connection cut ho jayega.

Uncle: Theek hai, main electricity office mein jaake check karunga.

Caller: Sir, office jaane ki zarurat nahi hai!

Uncle: Phir bhi main khud verify karunga. Dhanyavaad.

5. Fake customs parcel scam (20261103_002511_fca7)
Scam
 S0–S5


Caller: Hello sir, customs department se call kar raha hoon.

Uncle: Ji, boliye.

Caller: Sir, aapke naam pe ek international parcel intercept hua hai.

Uncle: Mere naam pe? Kisne bheja?

Caller: Sir, shipment mein restricted items mile hain. Isliye parcel customs investigation mein hai.

Uncle: Kya items hain?

Caller: Sir, usme suspicious documents aur prohibited material show ho raha hai.

Uncle: Arre, main toh koi parcel expect nahi kar raha hoon.

Caller: Sir, sender details abhi verify kar rahe hain. Aapka reference number hai 00001234.

Uncle: Achha, 00001234? Ek baar dheere boliye.

Caller: Zero zero zero zero one two three four.

Uncle: Haan, likh liya. Lekin sender kaun hai?

Caller: Sir, woh investigation ka part hai. Main aapko senior officer se connect karta hoon.

Uncle: Theek hai.

Caller: Hello sir, senior officer speaking. Aapko pata hai na ki international parcel mein prohibited items milna serious offence hai?

Uncle: Haan ji, lekin mera parcel hi nahi hai toh main kya karun?

Caller: Sir, aapka naam aur address registered hai. Aapko verification karna padega.

Uncle: Address kaise mila aapko?

Caller: Sir, customs database mein details hain.

Uncle: Toh mujhe official notice bhejiye. Main verify karunga.

Caller: Sir, aap cooperate nahi kar rahe hain. Case police ko transfer ho jayega.

Uncle: Aap transfer kar dijiye. Main bhi official customs office se baat karunga.

B. Genuine everyday calls (5)
These test whether Uncle can have ordinary conversations without unnecessarily treating callers as scammers.
6. Wrong number
Genuine
Caller: Hello, Ramesh ji hain kya?

Uncle: Nahi beta, yahan koi Ramesh nahi rehte.

Caller: Arre, ye 00001234 number nahi hai kya?

Uncle: Nahi ji, aap shayad galat number laga diye.

Caller: Oh, sorry uncle. Number galat save ho gaya hoga.

Uncle: Koi baat nahi beta. Hota hai.

Caller: Thank you uncle, sorry for disturbing.

Uncle: Arre koi baat nahi. Achha, rakhta hoon.

7. Relative asking for a lift
Genuine
Caller: Hello uncle! Kaise ho?

Uncle: Arre beta! Main theek hoon. Tu bata.

Caller: Uncle, main abhi railway station pe hoon. Aap free ho kya?

Uncle: Haan, kyun? Kya hua?

Caller: Bas uncle, train se aaya hoon. Auto mil nahi raha. Aap pick kar sakte ho kya?

Uncle: Haan beta, aa jaunga. Kitne baje pahunch gaya?

Caller: Abhi 10 minute hue.

Uncle: Achha, platform se bahar aa ja. Main 15–20 minute mein pahunchta hoon.

Caller: Thank you uncle!

Uncle: Koi baat nahi beta. Aur ghar pe sab theek hai?

8. Delivery person asking for address
Genuine
Caller: Hello sir, delivery executive bol raha hoon. Aapka parcel deliver karna tha.

Uncle: Achha beta, haan. Kahan ho aap?

Caller: Sir, main aapki street ke entrance pe hoon, lekin exact house nahi mil raha.

Uncle: Achha, aapko nearby shop dikh raha hai kya?

Caller: Haan sir, ek medical shop hai.

Uncle: Uske saamne left mein ek white gate hai. Wahi ghar hai.

Caller: Okay sir, main aa raha hoon.

Uncle: Theek hai beta. Aaram se aana.

Caller: Sir, aap ghar pe hi hain na?

Uncle: Haan, main ghar pe hi hoon.

9. Genuine bank FD reminder
Genuine
Caller: Good afternoon sir. Main aapke bank branch se bol raha hoon.

Uncle: Haan ji, bataiye.

Caller: Sir, aapki fixed deposit next week mature ho rahi hai. Isliye reminder call kar rahe hain.

Uncle: Achha, haan. Woh FD yaad hai mujhe.

Caller: Sir, aap maturity ke baad amount savings account mein credit karwana chahenge ya FD renew karna chahenge?

Uncle: Abhi toh socha nahi hai beta.

Caller: Koi baat nahi sir. Aap branch visit karke bhi decide kar sakte hain.

Uncle: Achha. Kitne din hain mere paas?

Caller: Sir, maturity date se pehle aap kabhi bhi branch aa sakte hain.

Uncle: Theek hai. Main agle hafte aa jaunga.

Caller: Thank you sir. Have a good day.

10. Friend calling to say hello
Genuine
Caller: Arre bhai! Kya haal hai?

Uncle: Arre! Kaun bol raha hai?

Caller: Main Suresh! Itni jaldi bhool gaye?

Uncle: Arre Suresh! Kaisa hai bhai? Bahut din baad yaad kiya!

Caller: Haan yaar, kaam mein busy tha. Socha aaj call kar loon.

Uncle: Achha kiya. Ghar pe sab kaise hain?

Caller: Sab badhiya. Aunty kaisi hain?

Uncle: Woh bhi theek hain. Bas thoda knee pain rehta hai.

Caller: Achha. Kabhi milne aana yaar.

Uncle: Haan bhai, zaroor. Tu bhi aa kabhi.

Caller: Chalo, phir milte hain. Take care.

Uncle: Haan bhai, dhyan rakhna.
